description: Cross-voice and cross-staff arpeggios. In the first bar, the <arpeggiate> elements all have the same ‘number’ attribute value, causing cross-staff arpeggios. In the second bar, the elements in the two staves have different ‘number’ attribute values, causing the arpeggios to be connected staff-wise. In the third bar there are different ‘number’ attribute values for each voice, causing arpeggios to be connected voice-wise.
